name: Gupta Empire
events: Important works on mathematics and astronomy are written in Sanskrit.
Emperor Chandragupta II, ruler of the Gupta Empire, begins a war against the Shaka Dynasty in West India.
King Rudrasimha III, ruler of the Western Satraps (India), is defeated by the Gupta Empire.
Fa-Hien, Chinese Buddhist monk, travels to India, Sri Lanka and Kapilavastu (modern Nepal).
Fa-Hien, Chinese Buddhist monk, makes a pilgrimage to India, initiating Sino-Indian relations.
Kumaragupta I succeeds his father Chandragupta II as emperor of the Gupta Empire (India).
A center of Buddhist studies is established at Nalanda in Bihar on the plains of the Ganges River (India).
Gunabhadra, Indian Buddhist monk, is an invited honored guest by emperor Wen of Liu Song (Liu Song dynasty).
Skandagupta succeeds Kumaragupta I as ruler of the Gupta Empire (India).
A statue of a Standing Buddha from Sarnath, Uttar Pradesh, (during the Gupta period) is made.

The Vishnu Temple at Deogarh, Uttar Pradesh (India) is built.
